title: Japanese Chicken and Rice Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired chicken and rice bowl with crunchy texture.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped green onions and sliced almonds to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the Japanese rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce and crunchy tortilla strips.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the rice is heated through and the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Transfer the chicken and rice mixture to a serving bowl and top with shredded Mexican cheese.
Garnish with additional green onions and sliced almonds, if desired.
